title: Human medial temporal lobe single units during a verbal working memory task (Boran et al.): spike times and waveforms aligned to OpenNeuro ds004752
description: Single-unit (microwire) recordings from the medial temporal lobe of nine patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a modified Sternberg verbal working memory task. The derivative provides 1526 sorted units and about 1.5 million spike times from hippocampus, entorhinal cortex and amygdala. It also includes mean and standard deviation waveforms, electrode and anatomical mapping, and trial tables. All of these are keyed to the subject and session labels of OpenNeuro ds004752 (NEMAR on004752) so the units can be combined with the scalp and intracranial EEG.
methods_description: Depth electrodes with protruding microwires were recorded on a Neuralynx ATLAS system (microwires at 32 kHz). Spikes were detected and sorted with Combinato (wavelet features, superparamagnetic clustering) followed by visual curation and merging of similar clusters. Electrode locations were derived from post-implantation CT and MRI, normalized to MNI space and labelled with the Brainnetome atlas. Patients performed a modified Sternberg task with set sizes of 4, 6 or 8 letters.
